$comment: High/critical advisories the audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) tolerates. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; renew only after re-checking for a patched release.

advisories.reason: ReDoS via attacker-controlled extglob patterns. No patched picomatch exists yet (latest 4.0.7 is affected). picomatch is only reached through build tooling (vite, vitest, tinyglobby, electron-builder) matching trusted repository globs; it is not a runtime dependency and is not shipped in the app.
